checks.original_claim: 1945년 바르샤바 봉기 당시 독일군에 의해 도난당했던 쇼팽의 심장
checks.source_1_title: Chopin's heart survives the Nazis - Times of Israel
checks.source_1_support: During the Warsaw Uprising (which began 1 August 1944), a German officer removed the heart on 9 September 1944 for safekeeping; it was returned to Warsaw on 17 October 1945.
checks.source_2_title: On a mission to save Chopin's Heart in 1944 - Warsaw Rising Museum
checks.source_2_support: Confirms the Warsaw Uprising and removal of the heart occurred in 1944; return occurred in 1945.
checks.reasoning: 재검증(2회차): 원문이 봉기 연도(1944)와 심장 반환 연도(1945)를 혼동함(원래 review 단계에서 예상한 대로). 봉기 연도만 1944로 정정. A군, 2건 독립 출처.
